name: o1 Launchpad
description: o1 Launchpad enables creators to launch and trade tokens on Base and Robinhood Chain through permanently locked Uniswap v4 liquidity.

methodology.Fees: Quote-denominated swap fees from Hook Trade events plus token-launch payment events across configured suites. Legacy launch-token-denominated swap fees are excluded because reliable historical USD valuation is unavailable. Crypto uses token balances; Stocks use the event-time factory tick reference price under the documented $4,000 opening-cap convention, with historical DefiLlama prices only when that reference is unavailable.
methodology.Revenue: Actual platform and protocol-owned fixed-component swap credits, plus token-launch fees. Includes anti-snipe surcharges, referral fallback and rounding retained by the protocol. Claims do not count again.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Swap and launch fees retained by the protocol treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Actual swap credits allocated to creators and referrers, including amounts still unclaimed.

Fees.Crypto Swap Fees: Crypto quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.
Fees.Crypto Launch Fees: Crypto token-launch fees from Factory payment events.
Fees.Stocks Swap Fees: Stocks quote-denominated swap fees, including anti-snipe surcharges.
Fees.Stocks Launch Fees: Stocks token-launch fees from Factory payment events.

Revenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Protocol: Crypto swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
Revenue.Crypto Launch Fees To Protocol: Crypto token-launch fees paid to the protocol.
Revenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Protocol: Stocks swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
Revenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

ProtocolRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Protocol: Crypto swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
ProtocolRevenue.Crypto Launch Fees To Protocol: Crypto token-launch fees paid to the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Protocol: Stocks swap fees credited to the protocol, including treasury-owned fixed components.
ProtocolRevenue.Stocks Launch Fees To Protocol: Stocks token-launch fees paid to the protocol.

SupplySideRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Creators: Crypto swap fees credited to token creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Crypto Swap Fees To Referrers: Crypto swap fees credited to valid referrers.
SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Creators: Stocks swap fees credited to token creators.
SupplySideRevenue.Stocks Swap Fees To Referrers: Stocks swap fees credited to valid referrers.
